description: This file defines SQLAlchemy ORM models for various HRMS entities such as Organization, User, Role, Employee, AttendanceSession, Holiday, Leave, PayrollCycle, and AuditLog, including their relationships and database table configurations.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Represents an organization with attributes like name, slug, status, and timestamps.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user associated with an organization, including login details and relationship to Employee.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Defines roles within an organization, including system roles and timestamps.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Defines permissions with key, description, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: Employee
classes.description: Represents an employee with personal and employment details, linked to User and organization.

classes.name: AttendanceSession
classes.description: Tracks attendance sessions for employees, including clock-in/out times and work mode.

classes.name: HolidayCalendar
classes.description: Holds holiday calendar details for an organization.

classes.name: Holiday
classes.description: Represents individual holidays linked to a calendar.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Defines types of leave, including whether paid, requires approval, and other attributes.

classes.name: LeaveBalance
classes.description: Tracks leave balances per employee and leave type.

classes.name: LeaveRequest
classes.description: Represents a leave request with status, dates, and reasons.

classes.name: LeaveApproval
classes.description: Records approval decisions for leave requests.

classes.name: PayrollCycle
classes.description: Defines payroll periods with start/end dates and status.

classes.name: AuditLog
classes.description: Logs actions performed within the system, including actor details and event metadata.

methods.name: mapped_column
methods.description: Defines columns in ORM models with types and constraints.
